description: Measure how well a set of probability predictions matched observed binary outcomes, returning the Brier score and log score (lower is better). Use to evaluate a forecaster's or model's calibration: predictions[i] is the probability assigned to event i and outcomes[i] is 1 if it occurred, else 0 (arrays must be equal length). Returns brier_score, log_score, the number of predictions, and the mean predicted vs mean observed rate. To measure agreement across multiple sources instead, use score_convergence.

outcomes.description: Binary realised outcomes. Must be the same length as predictions.

name: score_calibration

brier_score.description: Mean squared error between probability and outcome (lower is better).

log_score.description: Negative log-likelihood (lower is better; -inf possible if a 0-prob event happens).
